title: incus-spawn tool
description: A tool definition for isx: one YAML file in ~/.config/incus-spawn/tools/ or .incus-spawn/tools/. Only name is required.

name.description: The tool's name, as a template lists it. Letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', and it does not start with '.', '-' or '_'.

description.description: One line shown by isx tools and in build output.

package_repos.description: Additional package repositories to enable, as in a template.

type.description: The repository kind. copr is the only one.

name.description: The repository to enable, as owner/project.

downloads.description: Artifacts to download, cache on the host, and copy or extract into the instance. Each sets extract, destination_file, or both.

url.description: The http:// or https:// download URL. A local address such as localhost is refused.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum. Enables cache reuse and verifies integrity.

extract.description: Directory in the instance to extract into. Supports .tar.gz, .tgz, .tar.bz2, .tar.xz and .zip.

destination_file.description: Exact path at which to expose the downloaded file in the instance. ~/ resolves to /home/agentuser/.

extract_in_container.description: Extract inside the instance with its tar instead of on the host. A VM ignores it.

arch.description: Skip the download when the instance has another architecture.

links.description: Map of source_path: symlink_path to create after extraction.

files.description: Files to write in the instance.

path.description: Where the file goes in the instance.

content.description: What the file holds. ${param_<name>} takes a parameter's value.

owner.description: user:group to give the file, and its parent directories in that user's home that root owns.

merge.description: json to add the content to the JSON file already at path instead of replacing it.

strategy.description: How the value joins the variable: set (default), set-if-unset, prepend or append.

separator.description: Between the value and the existing one, for prepend and append.

requires.description: Other tools that must be installed first. An entry is a name, or a map such as idea-backend: {memory: 8g} to pass parameters.

verify.description: Verification command, logged and non-fatal. Runs as agentuser in a login shell with the image environment.

verify_as_root.description: true when the verify needs root. It then runs in root's own environment, without the environment file.

ready.description: Command each start polls until it succeeds, for up to 15 seconds, before handing the instance over.

parameters.description: Build-time parameters a template sets in its tools: list.

default.description: Its value when a template does not set it.

pattern.description: Regular expression a string value must match.

options.description: The allowed values, for an enum.

optional.description: Whether a template may leave the parameter out with no default.

reconfigurable.description: Whether the parameter may change on an existing instance.

feature.description: A feature flag the tool needs. A build skips the tool, with a warning, until the flag is listed under features: in config.yaml.

actions.description: Runtime actions the TUI offers when the tool is installed.

label.description: Display text shown in the F9 menu.

type.description: url opens url in the host browser, command runs command on the host, shell runs command in the instance, copy-to-clipboard copies text.

requires_running.description: Whether the instance must be running.

expand.description: repos generates one action per declared repository.

url.description: URL to open in the host browser, for type url.

command.description: Command to run, for type command (on the host) or shell (in the instance).

text.description: Text to copy to the host clipboard, for type copy-to-clipboard.

auto_return.description: Return without waiting for a key after the action completes.

shell_menu.description: Also show the action in the shell menu.

shortcut.description: A key that runs the action.

agent_note.description: An always-true fact about this tool that an agent must know before acting.

skills.description: Skills to install alongside the tool, teaching an agent how to drive it. Bare names resolve against this tool's own skills.repo.

repo.description: Catalog that bare skill names are resolved in.

list.description: owner/repo@skill, owner/repo, ./local-path or a bare name.

mcp.description: MCP servers the tool provides, registered with every coding agent in the image. Each is a stdio command or an HTTPS url.

command.description: The command that starts a stdio server, and its arguments.

env.description: Environment variables for a stdio server.

url.description: The HTTPS address of a remote server.

bearer-token-env.description: The variable an agent reads the bearer token from when it connects. One of the tool's own proxy placeholders.

proxy.description: Credential injection rules for the MITM proxy.

config-namespace.description: The namespace that scopes the config paths. Letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', starting with a letter or digit.

configuration.description: The host credentials, by key. isx init prompts for each.

type.description: string asks for a value, confirm asks yes or no.

secret.description: Whether the value is a credential: read without echo, redacted in support bundles.

config-path.description: Where the value is stored in config.yaml, under the namespace's selected account when relative.

value.description: A hardcoded literal, which isx init does not prompt for.

help.description: Lines printed before the prompt in place of the description.

auth.description: Entries mapping domains to authentication rules.

domains.description: The domains the rule applies to.

paths.description: Restrict the rule to these request paths.

type.description: bearer sends Authorization: Bearer <token>, basic sends Authorization: Basic with username and password, header sends the header name with value.

username.description: For basic: a literal or a ${configKey} reference.

password.description: For basic: a literal or a ${configKey} reference.

token.description: For bearer: a literal or a ${configKey} reference.

value.description: For header: the value, with ${configKey} substitution.

placeholders.description: The guest variables that carry proofs. The tool's env: value starts with the prefix followed by placeholder.

env.description: The environment variable the tool reads its credential from.

prefix.description: What the variable's value starts with, before isx_ and the proof.
